events.summary: UCDP records an interstate conflict between Government of Cambodia (Kampuchea) and Government of Thailand over control of Common Border, starting 2025-07-26. This episode was active in 1 year (2025–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: Earthquake: 2025 Kamchatka earthquake
events.summary: On 30 July 2025, at 11:24:52 PETT, a Mw 8.8 megathrust earthquake struck off the eastern coast of the Kamchatka Peninsula in the Russian Far East, 119 km (74 mi) east-southeast of the coastal city of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky.

events.title: Treaty signed: Armenia-Azerbaijan peace agreement
events.summary: The Armenia–Azerbaijan peace deal, officially titled the Agreement "On the Establishment of Peace and Interstate Relations between the Republic of Armenia and the Republic of Azerbaijan", aims to end the ongoing Nagorno-Karabakh conflict between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

events.title: Assassination: August 2025 Israeli attack on Sanaa
events.summary: On 28 August 2025, the Israeli Air Force (IAF) conducted targeted strikes, codenamed Operation Lucky Drop against several Houthi ministers in Bayt Baws, Sanaa, Yemen.

events.title: Assassination: Assassination of Andriy Parubiy
events.summary: Andriy Parubiy, a Ukrainian politician, was shot dead in Lviv, Ukraine, on 30 August 2025 at age 54. The attack occurred at around 10:35 am EEST on Yefremov Street. A suspect had been arrested in Khmelnytskyi Oblast by 1 September.

events.title: Earthquake: August 2025 Afghanistan earthquake
events.summary: On 31 August 2025, at 23:47 AFT, an earthquake with a magnitude of 6.0 on the moment magnitude scale (Mw) struck eastern Afghanistan, near the border with Pakistan. The epicenter of the quake was located in Nurgal District, Kunar Province.

events.title: 2025 Jamaican general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Jamaica on 3 September 2025. The incumbent Jamaica Labour Party (JLP) government, led by Prime Minister Andrew Holness, won a third term in office against the opposition People's National Party (PNP). However, the JLP lost 14 seats to the PNP, still retaining a majority.

events.title: 2025 Norwegian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 8 September 2025 to elect all 169 members of the Storting, the Norwegian parliament, for the 2025–2029 parliamentary term. Advance voting took place from 11 August to 5 September.

events.title: Battle: 2025 Russian drone incursion into Poland
events.summary: On 9 September 2025, at about 11:30 p.m. CEST, over 30 unarmed military drones entered Poland's airspace after allegedly being launched from Russia. The incursion triggered a Quick Reaction Alert; the Polish Air Force and other NATO militaries scrambled aircraft. Up to four drones were confirmed to have been shot down, most by the Dutch Air Force.

events.title: Assassination: assassination of Charlie Kirk
events.summary: On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk, an American right-wing political activist, was assassinated at Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah, while speaking at an outdoor campus debate planned by Turning Point USA, the conservative youth organization he co-founded and led.

events.title: Treaty signed: Strategic Mutual Defense Agreement
events.summary: The Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement (SMDA) is a security and defence pact between the countries of Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. Under this agreement both countries have committed to treating any act of aggression against one as an act against both known as collective security.

events.title: Inga Ruginienė takes power
events.summary: Inga Ruginienė is a Lithuanian trade unionist and politician serving as Minister of Social Security and Labour since 2026. Previously she served as the 19th Prime Minister of Lithuania from 25 September 2025 until 14 July 2026. A member of the Social Democratic Party of Lithuania, she has been a Member of the Seimas since 2024.

events.title: 2025 Moldovan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Moldova on 28 September 2025. Moldova is a parliamentary republic; the Parliament of Moldova has the main authority of creating laws and appointing the government, and executive powers are primarily derived from the legislature.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2025 Manchester synagogue attack
events.summary: On 2 October 2025, during the Jewish holiday of Yom Kippur, a man drove a black Kia Picanto into pedestrians before stabbing worshippers at the Heaton Park Hebrew Congregation, a synagogue in Higher Crumpsall, a northern suburb of the city of Manchester in North West England.

events.title: 2025 Czech parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in the Czech Republic on 3 and 4 October 2025, to elect all 200 members of the Chamber of Deputies, the lower house of the Czech Parliament.

events.title: 2025 Barbadian presidential election
events.summary: The 2025 Barbadian presidential election was held on 7 October 2025 to choose the second president of Barbados. Dame Sandra Mason, the inaugural president elected to replace Queen Elizabeth II as head of state of Barbados in 2021, completed her term on 29 November 2025, and chose to retire rather than run for a second term.

events.title: Sanae Takaichi takes power
events.summary: Sanae Takaichi is a Japanese politician who has been Prime Minister of Japan and President of the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) since October 2025. She is the first woman to hold either of these positions in Japanese history.

events.title: Andrej Babiš takes power
events.summary: Andrej Babiš is a Czech politician and businessman who has been the prime minister of the Czech Republic since December 2025, having previously served as prime minister from 2017 to 2021. Prior to that, he was the minister of finance and deputy prime minister from 2014 to 2017.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2025 Taipei knife attack
events.summary: On 19 December 2025, 27-year-old Chang Wen threw smoke grenades and stabbed people at two locations in Taipei, Taiwan, killing three people and injuring eleven others. Chang Wen fled from police and died when he fell from the Eslite Bookstore Nanxi building near Zhongshan Station.

events.title: Armed conflict breaks out: Yemen (North Yemen) vs STC (South Yemen)
events.summary: UCDP records a civil conflict between Government of Yemen (North Yemen) and STC over control of South Yemen, starting 2025-12-27. This episode was active in 1 year (2025–2025), below war level (25–999 battle deaths a year) and was still active in the latest data.

events.title: December 2025 Kosovan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Kosovo on 28 December 2025 to elect the 120 members of the Assembly. In the previous election in February 2025, no party had won a majority of seats, resulting in a hung parliament with Vetëvendosje, party of Prime Minister Albin Kurti, remaining the largest party.

events.title: 2026 Costa Rican general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 1 February 2026 to elect the president, two vice-presidents, and all 57 deputies of the Legislative Assembly.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Islamabad suicide bombing
events.summary: On 6 February 2026, a suicide attack occurred at the Khadija Tul Kubra Mosque, a Shia mosque in the Tarlai Kalan area of southeastern Islamabad, Pakistan. The explosion occurred during Friday prayer, killing 31 people and injuring over 169 others.

events.title: 2025–26 Republika Srpska presidential election
events.summary: Early presidential elections were held in Republika Srpska, an entity of Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 23 November 2025, and repeated ones in 17 municipalities on 8 February 2026.

events.title: 2026 Portuguese presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Portugal in 2026, with a first round on 18 January and a second round on 8 February. The incumbent president, Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, supported by the Social Democratic Party (PSD), had already served two consecutive terms, so he was not eligible for re-election.

events.title: 2026 Barbadian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Barbados on 11 February 2026 to elect the 30 members of the House of Assembly. Parliament was dissolved on 19 January and the final day for nominations was 27 January. The two leader candidates were Mia Mottley of the Barbados Labour Party and Ralph Thorne of the Democratic Labour Party.

events.title: Rob Jetten takes power
events.summary: Rob Arnoldus Adrianus Jetten is a Dutch politician who has served as prime minister of the Netherlands since February 2026. He has also served as leader of the Democrats 66 (D66) since August 2023.

events.title: Assassination: assassination of Ali Khamenei
events.summary: On 28 February 2026, Ali Khamenei, the supreme leader of Iran, was assassinated in Tehran as part of a series of Israeli airstrikes aimed at high-ranking Iranian officials. Khamenei's death was confirmed by the Iranian government on 1 March.

events.title: António José Seguro takes power
events.summary: António José Martins Seguro is a Portuguese politician who has been the president of Portugal since 2026, having won the 2026 Portuguese presidential election. A member of the Socialist Party (PS), Seguro previously served as secretary-general of the PS from 2011 to 2014, during which time he was also the leader of the opposition.

events.title: Assassination: assassination of Ali Larijani
events.summary: On 17 March 2026, Ali Larijani, the secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, was assassinated in Tehran as part of a series of Israeli airstrikes aimed at high-ranking Iranian officials. His death occurred as part of the 2026 Iran war, which began on 28 February with airstrikes on various Iranian targets by the United States and Israel.

events.title: 2026 Slovenian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Slovenia on 22 March 2026. The elections determined the composition of the National Assembly, which determines the government of Slovenia.

events.title: 2026 Italian constitutional referendum
events.summary: A constitutional referendum concerning the reform of the judicial system was held in Italy on 22 and 23 March 2026. Its purpose was to revise Title II and Title IV of Part II of the Italian constitution. It was the fifth constitutional referendum in the history of the Italian Republic.

events.title: Epidemic: MV Hondius hantavirus outbreak
events.summary: In April 2026, an outbreak of hantavirus infection caused by the Andes virus was identified on the Dutch cruise ship MV Hondius. There were ten confirmed cases and two suspected cases directly linked to the outbreak as of 22 May. There have been three deaths, two of which have been confirmed as caused by the Andes virus, the last on 2 May.

events.title: 2026 Hungarian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 12 April 2026 to elect all 199 members of the National Assembly. It was the 10th parliamentary election and the highest-turnout election since Hungary's transition to democracy in 1990.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Kyiv shooting
events.summary: On 18 April 2026, a mass shooting occurred in the Demiivka neighborhood of the Holosiivskyi District of Kyiv, Ukraine, when a man opened fire on his neighbours and passers-by in the street before taking hostages inside a supermarket. He was shot and killed by police in a shootout when the Rapid Operational Response Unit (KORD) stormed the supermarket.

events.title: 2026 Bulgarian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Bulgaria on 19 April 2026 to elect 240 members of the National Assembly. The vote was triggered by the resignation of the Zhelyazkov government on 11 December 2025 following widespread anti-corruption protests.

events.title: 2026 Antiguan general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 30 April 2026 to elect members of the House of Representatives. The Antigua and Barbuda Labour Party (ABLP) had held a slim majority of seats since the 2023 election, making further gains in Parliament following the election of Rawdon Turner and the unofficial floor walk of Anthony Smith.

events.title: Rumen Radev takes power
events.summary: Rumen Georgiev Radev is a Bulgarian politician and former Bulgarian Air Force officer who is the prime minister of Bulgaria. He previously served as president of Bulgaria from 2017 until his resignation in 2026.

events.title: Laura Fernández Delgado takes power
events.summary: Laura Virginia Fernández Delgado is a Costa Rican politician and political scientist who has served as the president of Costa Rica since 2026. As the presidential candidate of the Sovereign People's Party, Fernández won the 2026 presidential election.

events.title: Péter Magyar takes power
events.summary: Péter Magyar is a Hungarian politician who has served as prime minister of Hungary since May 2026. He has been the president of the Tisza Party since 2024 and was a member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2024 to 2026.

events.title: 2026 Bahamian general election
events.summary: General elections were held in the Bahamas on 12 May 2026 to elect all 41 members of the House of Assembly. The election was called early by Prime Minister Philip Davis, with Parliament dissolved on 8 April 2026 and the writs of election issued the following day.

events.title: 2026 Cypriot legislative election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Cyprus on 24 May 2026 to elect 56 of the 80 members of the House of Representatives.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Quetta train bombing
events.summary: On 24 May 2026, a vehicle-borne suicide bombing targeted a shuttle train near Chaman Phatak in Quetta, Balochistan, Pakistan. The explosion killed at least 47 people and injured 98 others.

events.title: Andris Kulbergs takes power
events.summary: Andris Kulbergs is a Latvian businessman and politician serving as the prime minister of Latvia since 2026. Before being elected to the Saeima as a non-party member of the United List ticket in 2022, he worked in a number of roles in the private sector. He also serves as the president of the Latvian Authorised Automobile Dealers Association.

events.title: 2026 Maltese general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Malta on 30 May 2026, with 356,832 registered voters entitled to vote to elect all members of the House of Representatives. The ruling Labour Party led by Robert Abela won the election, securing 36 seats with 52% of the first preference vote.

events.title: 2026 Hamburg Olympics referendum
events.summary: The 2026 Hamburg Olympic referendum was a citywide referendum held on 31 May 2026 in the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg. Voters were asked whether the German Olympic Sports Confederation (DOSB), should apply with Hamburg as the host city for the Olympic and Paralympic Games in 2036, 2040 or 2044.

events.title: Janez Janša takes power
events.summary: Ivan Janša, better known as Janez Janša, is a Slovenian politician who has served as Prime Minister of Slovenia since 2026, a position he previously held from 2004 to 2008, from 2012 to 2013 and from 2020 to 2022. Since 1993, Janša has led the Slovenian Democratic Party, which has emerged as the pre-eminent Slovenian right-wing party.

events.title: 2026 Armenian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Armenia on 7 June 2026 to elect members of the 9th convocation of the National Assembly. According to exit polls, incumbent Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan's party Civil Contract won with 56.7% of the vote, followed by the pro-Russian Strong Armenia of Samvel Karapetyan with 17.5%.

events.title: 2026 Kosovan parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Kosovo on 7 June 2026. The elections follow a constitutional crisis triggered by the Assembly's failure to elect a president.

events.title: Earthquake: 2026 Mindanao earthquake
events.summary: On June 8, 2026, at 07:37:40 PhST, a Mw 7.8 earthquake struck offshore southern Mindanao in the Philippines. The United States Geological Survey located the epicenter approximately 25 km (16 mi) southwest of Kablalan at a depth of about 57 km (35 mi), while the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology located it 32 km (20 mi) south of Maasim,…

events.title: Earthquake: 2026 Venezuela earthquakes
events.summary: On 24 June 2026, doublet large strike-slip earthquakes affected northwestern and central Venezuela. The epicenter of the first earthquake was in Veroes Municipality, west of San Felipe, the capital city of Yaracuy. This earthquake, which measured Mw 7.2, occurred at 18:04 VET and was classified as a foreshock.

events.title: Mindaugas Sinkevičius takes power
events.summary: Mindaugas Sinkevičius is a Lithuanian manager and politician, who has served as the 20th Prime Minister of Lithuania since 14 July 2026. He also served as Mayor of Jonava District Municipality, former Minister of Economy of Lithuania (2016–2017) and Vice-Mayor of Jonava (2008–2011).

events.title: Andy Burnham takes power
events.summary: Andrew Murray Burnham is a British politician who has served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Labour Party since July 2026.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Berlin Pride van attack
events.summary: On the evening of 25 July 2026, 21-year-old Lebanese-German Abdul Ballout drove a van into a crowd of pedestrians during Berlin Christopher Street Day, a pride celebration in the Tiergarten in central Berlin, Germany. One woman was killed and 29 people were injured, several critically. Ballout fled on foot, and a large-scale manhunt was launched.

events.title: Earthquake: 2026 Kumamoto earthquake
events.summary: On 28 July 2026 at approximately 16:27:15 JST, an earthquake struck Kumamoto Prefecture in southern Japan with a magnitude of Mww 6.8 at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi), later revised to 16 km (9.9 mi). At least 38 people were killed and more than 368 were injured.

events.title: Treaty signed: Mecca Joint Defence Agreement
events.summary: The Mecca Defence Alliance, also known as the Mecca Pact or Makkah Alliance, is an intergovernmental military alliance in the Muslim world that was signed into force by Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey on 7 August 2026.

events.title: Earthquake: 2026 Colombia earthquake
events.summary: On 10 August 2026, a Mw 7.4–7.5 earthquake struck the department of Chocó in Colombia, killing at least 335 people, injuring more than 4,600 others, leaving 111 confirmed missing and causing extensive damage across the country.

events.title: 2026 Hungarian presidential election
events.summary: An early indirect presidential election was held in Hungary on 11 August 2026 following Tamás Sulyok's removal by constitutional amendment. András Baka, a former president of the Supreme Court of Hungary, was nominated by the governing Tisza Party and was elected with a two-thirds majority.

events.title: Natural disaster: 2026 Nepal–Tibet floods
events.summary: On the morning of 26 August 2026, a series of flash floods and debris flows destroyed the Gyirong Port on the China–Nepal border and struck dozens of settlements along a 72 km (45 mi) stretch of the Trishuli River in Nepal. These events are also known as the 2026 Nepal-China floods, Bhotekoshi flood, or Rasuwa flood.

events.title: 2026 Icelandic European Union membership negotiations referendum
events.summary: A referendum on the resumption of European Union membership negotiations by the Icelandic government was held in Iceland on 29 August 2026. Its result was to reject the proposal for resuming accession negotiations with 52.84% voting no and 47.16% voting yes.

events.title: Coup: 2026 Nigerien coup attempt
events.summary: On 28–29 August 2026, a mutinous faction of the Niger Armed Forces calling themselves the Armed Forces for the Restoration of the Fatherland attempted a coup against President Abdourahamane Tiani in the country's capital Niamey.

events.title: 2026 Swedish general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Sweden on 13 September 2026 to elect the 349 members of the Riksdag, alongside municipal and regional elections.

events.title: Terrorist attack: 2026 Kohat attack
events.summary: On 18 September 2026, armed insurgents attacked and occupied the Old Police Lines complex in Kohat, Pakistan. After an initial attack on the Old Police Lines mosque, a battle and clearance operation continued for about 22 hours, resulting in 31 deaths and 103 injuries.

events.title: 2026 Russian legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections were held in Russia from 18 to 20 September 2026, to elect all 450 seats of the 9th State Duma, the lower house of the Federal Assembly. Going into the election, United Russia was the incumbent and largest party with 310 seats.

events.title: 2026 French Senate election
events.summary: Senatorial elections were held in France on 27 September 2026 to select 178 members of the French Senate in indirect elections.

events.title: 2026 Czech Senate election
events.summary: The first round of the election to the Senate, the upper house of the Parliament of the Czech Republic, were held on 9 and 10 October 2026, along with the 2026 municipal elections. In districts where second round run-off was necessary, voters elected a Senator by a simple majority on 16 and 17 October.

events.title: 2026 Latvian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Latvia on 3 October 2026, following the end of the term of the fourteenth Saeima elected in 2022.

events.title: 2026 Republika Srpska general election
events.summary: General elections were held in Republika Srpska on 4 October 2026 as part of the Bosnian general elections. Voters decided the President of Republika Srpska, the two Vice-Presidents of Republika Srpska, and the 83 members of the National Assembly of Republika Srpska.

events.title: 2026 Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina general election
events.summary: The Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina held general elections on 4 October 2026 as part of the Bosnian general elections. Voters elected the 98 members of the House of Representatives of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, as well as the assemblies of the ten cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

events.title: 2026 Slovenian referendum
events.summary: A four-question non-binding referendum was held in Slovenia on 11 October 2026. The questions were:Overturning the Law on Parliamentary Investigation that was adopted by the National Assembly in May 2026 Making social assistance conditional on carrying out of community service Limiting voting rights in local elections to Slovenian and EU citizens Abolition…

events.title: 2026 Bulgarian presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 25 October 2026. Incumbent president Iliana Iotova is eligible and has declared her intention to run for a full term.

events.title: 2026 Serbian parliamentary election
events.summary: Early parliamentary elections were held in Serbia on 25 October 2026 to elect members of the National Assembly. The elections were originally due by December 2027; Aleksandar Vučić, then the president of Serbia, dissolved the National Assembly and called the elections on 9 September 2026, on the proposal of the government.

events.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
events.summary: Legislative elections are scheduled to be held in Israel on 27 October 2026, to elect all 120 members of the 26th Knesset and determine the governing coalition that succeeds the 37th government led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

events.title: 2026 Navajo Nation presidential election
events.summary: The 2026 Navajo Nation presidential election will take place on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, to elect the president and vice president of the Navajo Nation. The primary election was held on June 2 in New Mexico, June 23 in Utah, and July 21 in Arizona to align with each state's primary elections.

events.title: 2026 United States Senate elections
events.summary: The 2026 United States Senate elections are scheduled to be held on November 3, 2026, with 33 of the 100 seats in the Senate being contested in regular elections. In these elections, voters will elect candidates to six-year terms that begin on January 3, 2027, and expire on January 3, 2033.

events.title: 2026 Spanish general election
events.summary: A general election will be held in Spain on 29 November 2026 to elect the members of the 16th Cortes Generales under the Spanish Constitution of 1978. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies will be up for election, as well as 209 of 267 seats in the Senate.

events.title: Next Estonian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections will be held in Estonia by 7 March 2027 to elect all 101 members of the Riigikogu.

events.title: 2027 Finnish parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections will be held in Finland on 18 April 2027 to elect members of parliament for the 2027–2031 term. It will be the first parliamentary election in Finland since the country acceded to NATO on 4 April 2023, ending 75 years of military non-alignment for the country.

events.title: 2027 French presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in France on 18 April 2027, with a second round on 2 May if no candidate secures a majority vote. The election may be held earlier under exceptional circumstances if the presidency falls vacant before then.

events.title: 2026 Grenadian general election
events.summary: General elections are scheduled to be held in Grenada on 5 November 2026.

events.title: Next Italian general election
events.summary: General elections will occur in Italy no later than 22 December 2027.

events.title: 2026 Nicaraguan general election
events.summary: General elections were due to be held in Nicaragua to elect the co-presidents and members of the National Assembly. Originally scheduled for November 2026, a constitutional amendment pushed back the election date to November 2027.

events.title: 2028 United States Senate elections
events.summary: The 2028 United States Senate elections will be held on November 7, 2028, with 34 of the 100 seats in the Senate being contested in regular elections, the winners of which will serve 6-year terms in the United States Congress from January 3, 2029, to January 3, 2035, which will include the entire term of the president who wins the 2028 presidential election…

events.title: 2028 United States presidential election
events.summary: Presidential elections are scheduled to be held in the United States on November 7, 2028, to elect the president and vice president to a four-year term, with the winners scheduled to be inaugurated on January 20, 2029.

events.title: 2029 Norwegian parliamentary election
events.summary: Parliamentary elections will be held in September 2029 to elect representatives to Norway's parliament, the Storting, for the period of 2029–2033.
